page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin, running down beside the verse and text. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.head: Oftia oppidum Latij.
main_text.p: Idem Fest. lib.4. Virgil. Aeneid.lib.1.Oftia contigerat, quâ fe Tiberinus in altum Dimidit, & campo liberiore natat. Carthago, Italiam contra, Tyberinâque longè Oftia.
main_text.head: Canusium, Barus, Gnatia, oppida Appuliæ.
main_text.p: Horat. Serm. lib.1. Canusium à Diomede condidit.Nam Canusi lapidosus, aqua non ditior vrna, Qui locus à forti Diomede est conditus olim. Postera tempestas melior, via peior adusque Bari moenia pissosi, debinc Gnatia lymphis Iratis extructa dedit, risusque, iocosque.
main_text.head: Aricia oppidum Latij Dianæ dicatum in via Appia ad Albanum montem.
main_text.p: Horat. lib.1. Sermonum.Egressum magna, me excepit Aricia Roma Hospitio modico.
—Inde Forum Appi Differtum nautis, cauponibus atque malignis.
Ovid. Fast. lib. 3.Inter Aricinos, Albanáque tempora constat, Factáque Telegoni moenia celsa manu.

Mendici Ariciæ ad templum Dianæ plurimi olim sedebat. Iuvenalis Satyra 5. Stat.Syl.li.4.Dignus Aricinos qui mendicaret ad axes. Fumat Aricinum Triuia nemus, & face multa Conscius Hyppolyti splendet lacus. ipsa coronat Emeritos Diana canes, & spicula tergit, Et tutas finit ire feras, omnisque pudicis Itala terra focis Hecateias excolit ædus.
main_text.head: Alba oppidum Latij.
main_text.p: Alba oppidû in via Appia situm. Stat. ibidem.Aft ego Dardania quanuis sub collibus Albæ Ruus proprium, magnique ducis mihi munere currens Unda mihi curas mulcere, astuisque leuare Sufficerent.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are set in small italic type and are transcribed as listed. The final word "talis" is set at the lower right in italic. Some words in the verse are doubtful due to the age and show-through of the scan, notably the Greek-derived names and the verse line "Itala terra focis"; the printed "ædus" may be a misreading of "ædis"; "Alba oppidû" in the note may be a misreading. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
